sections.name: 07 · FAQ
groups:
A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS
Before you
jump in.

What can I teach my agent?
Import files, website URLs, a sitemap, or pasted text. Source status shows when knowledge is ready to use.

Can a customer ask for a human?
Yes. Your team can take over in the shared inbox, with the conversation history and AI paused.

How do I install Cogni?
Authorize your domain and add the widget loader to your website.
